title: 3D-printed equipment mount
summary: Designed, fitted and iterated a compact mount for real equipment.
problem: Create a robust attachment that fits existing hardware and can be manufactured quickly.
solution: Measured the interfaces, modelled the part parametrically, printed prototypes and refined the fit.
results: Design retained as editable parametric model

title: Mechanical repair fixture
summary: Example structure for documenting a repair, modification or practical engineering job.
problem: A component or assembly no longer performs as intended.
solution: Diagnose the failure, identify constraints, repair or redesign the affected part and verify function.

title: Hull analysis tool
summary: Component-aware 3D model viewer and hydrostatic analysis workspace.
problem: Engineering model viewers and analysis tools are often fragmented.
solution: Use one semantic model for rendering, hydrostatics and future structural/CFD modules.
